title: Governance Lifecycle Record
description: Canonical attributable, integrity-protected record of a Governed Action Proposal lifecycle. DS-038 derives authoritative lifecycle state from ordered Governance Ledger records, preserves complete transition history and transition basis, distinguishes terminal from nonterminal state, records approval, refusal, expiration, cancellation, degradation, re-evaluation, recovery, commitment, and execution effects, and binds every lifecycle fact to stable Proposal Identity. It is not an uncontrolled mutable operational status flag and does not itself authorize execution.

governance_lifecycle_record_id.description: Stable identifier for a DS-038 Governance Lifecycle Record.

lifecycle_transition_id.description: Stable identifier for a lifecycle transition within a DS-038 record.

terminality_enum.description: Whether the authoritative lifecycle state is terminal for the applicable Proposal Identity instance.

derived_lifecycle_state.description: Canonical Derived Lifecycle State. PROFILE_ values require a controlled implementation profile. Transient internal processing states are prohibited.

lifecycle_state_snapshot.description: Authoritative lifecycle-state snapshot derived from ordered ledger events.

lifecycle_state_ref.description: Stable integrity-bound reference to authoritative Derived Lifecycle State.

transition_basis.description: Canonical decision, approval, authorization, refusal, receipt, continuation, configuration, policy, and evidence basis supporting a lifecycle transition.

lifecycle_transition.description: Attributable lifecycle transition supported by a permitted transition basis and an ordered ledger event.

lifecycle_transition_ref.description: Stable integrity-bound reference to a DS-038 lifecycle transition.

ledger_derivation.description: Deterministic derivation of current lifecycle state from authoritative ordered Governance Ledger records.

namespaced_extensions.description: Namespaced non-normative extensions that cannot alter canonical lifecycle state or transition semantics.

governance_lifecycle_record_ref.description: Stable integrity-bound reference to a DS-038 Governance Lifecycle Record.
